title: Can Quantum Federated Learning Withstand Circuit-Level Backdoors?
summary: Quantum Federated Learning (QFL) inherits the core vulnerability of federated optimization to malicious clients, while also introducing an attack surface from variational circuit training and measurement-driven gradients. This work proposes a novel CircUit-Level backdoor Threat (CULT) model that formalizes four stealthy attacks by exploiting quantum-aware mechanisms, including Grover, Pauli, Bit-flip, and Sign-flip.
